_: Role bindings for memos' own component library, extracted by adapt-react and bound by hand.
This file is the judgment tier, and it is the reason the extraction stops where it does.
adapt-react can prove that Badge exists, takes a `variant` of five values and a `shape` of
two, and is imported from @/components/ui/badge. It cannot know that Badge is what this
project uses to show a status, or that its `warning` variant is the one to reach for when
something needs attention rather than `destructive`. Nobody ships that, in any library.
An unbound role is reported by `ds spec` as unbuildable rather than guessed at.

tone._: memos has no `success` variant. A tone this project does not express is absent here rather than mapped to the nearest thing, so a spec asking for it fails loudly.

searchInput._: memos has no dedicated search field. Its Input inherits the DOM attributes, so the role is answered by the type rather than by a component that does not exist.
